purpose: Complete Stellarium Chinese line-star coverage and western zodiac line-star coverage for the magnitude-limited lite TSC1 catalog.

attribution: Chinese sky culture initially contributed by Karrie Berglund of Digitalis Education Solutions, Inc., based on Hong Kong Space Museum star maps.
Sun Shuwei contributed more than 200 Chinese asterisms and more than 3,000 star names, primarily based on Yi Shitong's Chinese and Western Contrast Star Chart and Catalogue 1950.0.
Chinese text reworked by the Stellarium team; western sky culture by the Stellarium team.
